mcq.q: Which of the following is NOT a web browser?
mcq.e: MINIX is an operating system. Mosaic, Opera and Safari are genuine browsers.

mcq.q: Which of the following is a search engine rather than only a web browser?
mcq.e: Lycos (like Google and Yahoo) locates information on the Web. Internet Explorer is a browser, not a search engine.

mcq.q: The three parts that make up a URL are:
mcq.e: A URL gives the location of a resource using protocol + hostname + directory/filename.

mcq.q: Which URL scheme is used to send electronic mail from a hyperlink?
mcq.e: The e-mail link is written as a href="mailto:address".

mcq.q: A rough outline of what a finished website will look like, showing content per page and navigation between pages, is produced by:
mcq.e: Wireframes give a rough outline of the site, showing which content is on which page and how pages are navigated.

mcq.q: Which of the following is NOT a front-end technology?
mcq.e: HTML, CSS and JavaScript run in the browser (front end). PL/SQL is not a front-end technology.

mcq.q: Match: Front-End Framework, Asset, Boilerplate, JavaScript Library. Which set of pairs is correct?
o: Tailwind CSS, Font Awesome, Reset CSS, React JS
Font Awesome, Tailwind CSS, React JS, Reset CSS
Reset CSS, React JS, Tailwind CSS, Font Awesome
React JS, Reset CSS, Font Awesome, Tailwind CSS
mcq.e: Framework = Tailwind CSS, Asset = Font Awesome, Boilerplate = Reset CSS, JavaScript Library = React JS.

mcq.q: DHTML is best described as:
o: A technique combining HTML, JavaScript, DOM and CSS to make pages interactive
A new programming language for servers
mcq.e: DHTML (Dynamic HTML) is not a programming language; it is the art of combining HTML, JavaScript, DOM and CSS.

mcq.q: HTML is derived from which of the following?
mcq.e: HTML is a markup language derived from SGML (Standard Generalized Markup Language).

mcq.q: Which tag is the root tag of an HTML document?
mcq.e: Everything in a page nests inside <html>, the root. <head> holds information about the page and <body> holds visible content.

mcq.q: Which statement about HTML attributes is FALSE?
o: They are specified in the end tag
They provide additional information about an element
mcq.e: Attributes are written in the START tag, not the end tag.

mcq.q: Which of the following is NOT an attribute of the <hr> tag?
mcq.e: <hr> takes SIZE, WIDTH, ALIGN and NOSHADE. SHADE is not an attribute.

mcq.q: Which of the following is an empty (void) element with no closing tag?
mcq.e: inserts a line break and has no content or closing tag. Heading, cell and superscript tags enclose content.

mcq.q: Which tag creates the largest of the six HTML heading levels?
mcq.e: HTML supports six heading levels, from <h1> (largest) to <h6> (smallest).

mcq.q: Which target value opens the linked document in the full body of the window?
mcq.e: _top loads the document in the full window body. _self = same frame, _parent = parent frame, _blank = new tab.

mcq.q: In the BODY tag, which attribute sets the colour of a link that has already been clicked (visited)?
mcq.e: LINK is for unvisited links, VLINK for visited links and ALINK for active links.

mcq.q: Which HTML5 tag encapsulates a group of links?
mcq.e: <nav> groups navigation links. <cite> marks titles of works, <bdo> changes text direction, <figure> holds images and graphs.

mcq.q: Which tag is used to mark up the titles of works of art, music, movies or books?
mcq.e: <cite> marks titles of creative works. <bdo> changes text directionality and <sup> gives superscript.

mcq.q: Which bullet style is NOT available for an HTML unordered list?
mcq.e: Unordered list bullets are disc, circle and square; there is no triangle.

mcq.q: Which tag and attribute change an ordered list so that it is numbered with capital letters?
mcq.e: The TYPE attribute of <OL> sets the numbering style. START only changes the first number.

mcq.q: Which attribute of the tag gives the text displayed when the image cannot be shown?
mcq.e: ALT supplies the fallback text for an image that cannot be displayed.

mcq.q: Which tag defines a table data cell?
mcq.e: <td> is a data cell, <tr> a row, <th> a header cell and <table> encloses the whole table.

mcq.q: Which table attribute controls the distance between the data in a cell and the cell's boundaries?
mcq.e: CELLPADDING cushions content inside a cell. CELLSPACING is the gap between cells.

mcq.q: In an HTML5 style sheet context, which is the correct way to link an external CSS file?
mcq.e: An external style sheet (.css file) is linked with a <link> tag, not <style> or <a>.

mcq.q: CSS rules placed inside a <style> element in the <head> are called:
mcq.e: Inline CSS uses the style attribute of a tag, internal uses <style> in the head, and external uses a separate .css file.

mcq.q: Which CSS layout system is two-dimensional (rows and columns together)?
mcq.e: CSS Grid handles rows and columns (2-D), while Flexbox is one-dimensional (a single line).

mcq.q: Which tag pair must enclose JavaScript code embedded in an HTML page?
mcq.e: JavaScript is placed inside the <script> tag pair.

mcq.q: Which JavaScript dialog box shows a message with both OK and Cancel buttons?
mcq.e: alert() shows only OK, prompt() asks for text input, and confirm() offers OK and Cancel.

mcq.q: Which of the following is NOT a valid JavaScript identifier?
mcq.e: An identifier may start with a letter, underscore or dollar sign, never a digit.
The browser collapses the newline character to a space, so the page shows Hello India.

mcq.q: var obj = {age:25}; Object.defineProperty(obj,'age',{writable:false}); obj.age = 30; console.log(obj.age); prints:
mcq.e: With writable:false the assignment is silently ignored, so the value stays 25.

mcq.q: Which of the following does NOT exist as a document method in JavaScript?
mcq.e: getElementsByWrite() is a fake. The other three are real document methods.

mcq.q: Match the events: onchange, onmouseover, onkeydown, onload. Which is correct?
o: onchange: element changed; onmouseover: mouse moves over; onkeydown: key pushed; onload: page finished loading
onchange: page loaded; onmouseover: key pushed; onkeydown: mouse moves over; onload: element changed
onchange: key pushed; onmouseover: element changed; onkeydown: page loaded; onload: mouse moves over
onchange: mouse moves over; onmouseover: page loaded; onkeydown: element changed; onload: key pushed
mcq.e: onchange fires when an element changes, onmouseover when the mouse moves over, onkeydown when a key is pushed, onload when the page finishes loading.

mcq.q: Which pair of events is needed to change a link's colour on hover and restore it afterwards?
mcq.e: OnMouseOver applies the hover colour and OnMouseOut restores it.

mcq.q: In AJAX, the letter X stands for:
mcq.e: AJAX = Asynchronous JavaScript and XML.

mcq.q: When an ASP.NET page on an IIS server is viewed in a browser, the page received contains:
o: All HTML code only (the server code is not sent)
The ASP.NET server code and the HTML
mcq.e: Server-side code runs on the server and the visitor sees only its HTML output.

mcq.q: Which PHP function sorts an array in ascending order WITHOUT affecting the keys?
mcq.e: asort() keeps key-value associations. sort() re-indexes and ksort() sorts by key.

mcq.q: Which object in ASP provides global storage accessible to all pages of a web application?
mcq.e: The Application object holds global state for all pages, whereas Session is per user.

mcq.q: Which attribute must a server control carry in ASP.NET?
mcq.e: A server control must have runat="server" so it is processed on the server.

mcq.q: Which of the following is NOT a valid XML element name?
mcq.e: XML names cannot start with a number (nor with the letters xml) and cannot contain spaces.

mcq.q: Which is the correct XML prolog (declaration)?
mcq.e: The XML declaration opens with a question-mark form: <?xml version="1.0"?>.

mcq.q: Which statement correctly attaches an external DTD to an XML document?
mcq.e: An external DTD is referenced with <!DOCTYPE root-element SYSTEM "file-name">. <!ELEMENT> declares an element.

mcq.q: Which of the following is NOT an XML parser?
mcq.e: DOM, SAX and JDOM are real XML parsers; Shell is not.

mcq.q: The XML parser that builds the whole document as a tree structure in memory is the:
mcq.e: The DOM parser holds the whole tree in memory with random access; SAX streams events.

tf.s: The Internet is a network of networks.
tf.n: The internet is described as a large network of networks, first used for military intelligence.

tf.s: Internet Explorer is a search engine.
tf.n: Internet Explorer is a web browser; Google, Yahoo and Lycos are search engines.

tf.s: HTML is a programming language with variables and loops.
tf.n: HTML is a markup language, not a programming language; it defines page structure.

tf.s: A static website changes its content at runtime.
tf.n: A static site serves the same content on every load; changing content at runtime is a dynamic site.

tf.s: The HTML form tag can appear only once on a page.
tf.n: There is no maximum limit on the number of forms on a page (though forms cannot nest).

tf.s: In CSS, HSL stands for hue, saturation and lightness.
tf.n: HSL specifies colour using hue (0-360 degrees), saturation percent and lightness percent.

tf.s: Flexbox is a two-dimensional layout system while CSS Grid is one-dimensional.
tf.n: It is the reverse: CSS Grid is two-dimensional (rows and columns) and Flexbox is one-dimensional.

tf.s: In JavaScript, a callback is a function passed into another function as a parameter.
tf.n: That is the definition of a callback.

tf.s: In PHP, passing an argument by reference (&) changes the original value when it is modified inside the function.
tf.n: Pass-by-reference works on the original variable, not a copy.

tf.s: XML tag names can begin with a numeric value.
tf.n: XML names cannot start with a number, nor with the letters xml, and cannot contain spaces.

tf.s: XML Schemas support datatypes, while DTDs do not.
tf.n: XML Schema adds datatypes that a DTD lacks.

tf.s: A Java servlet can run without a web server.
tf.n: A servlet runs inside a web server and receives requests and responds using HTTP.

The HTML attribute that holds the destination of a hyperlink in an anchor tag is ______.

The JavaScript dialog box that requests text input from the user is ______( ).
In classic ASP, the default scripting language is ______.
In PHP, the function that stores data in a cookie variable is ______( ).
The jQuery method that slides an element down to reveal it is ______( ).
